note: Sanitized aggregate of the WD-022a live Claude passes. Counts, kinds, durations and outcome tallies only; no prompts, paths, commands, tool output, or native identities. The pass_A_concurrent_four / sequential_single_session / harness_observed_hook_delta_ms blocks are the FIRST (pre-fix) CLI pass and are kept as the historical record; post_fix_reverification is the current state after removing the git rev-parse subprocess from checkout resolution.
user_settings_sha256: baseline b84accab...9bc moved to b03519ab...a2d3; Claude Code re-normalizes its own global settings file on every launch (default keys); no Watchdog code writes under ~/.claude

sequential_single_session.note: Sequential stream deltas exceed the concurrent ones (below). The hook_started/hook_response stream delta is contaminated by Claude's stdout-flush and event-loop cadence and is not a trustworthy hook wall-time on this build.

harness_observed_hook_delta_ms.source: t(hook_response) - t(hook_started), monotonic read timestamps on the --include-hook-events stream

pre_fix_adapter_launch_cost_ms.source: scripts/benchmark_hooks.py against the same binary, isolated, 20 samples

post_fix_reverification.change: filesystem checkout resolution (git_checkout / discover); git rev-parse spawned only for unrecognized layouts. Plus disk::fault: attributable, content-free, rotating faults.log.

adapter_launch_cost_ms.source: scripts/benchmark_hooks.py, same binary, isolated, 20 samples, direct exec form
